The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declines TokenAuthentication for user login because the token is long-lived, stored as plain text and never expires, and points to simplejwt
- Recommends permissions through named groups rather than on individual users, with few superusers
- Mentions setting AUTH_USER_MODEL before the first migration

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
